reviewer: Single implementation agent; focused Code/Rule and producer receiver review, not independent review or a full audit wave.
source_findings: Known P06 migration and integration findings are addressed in source. Executed validation is pending; no whole-PR clearance.
remedies: Typed public vista point/elevation APIs and aggregate native finite-difference completion.
Required mesh errors propagate through focused/generation/backdrop preparation; all discovered callers and ignored fixture compile paths adapted.
Wasm preparation failure classification covers VistaMesh.
Core scene stair records retain checked support and point leaves; count/going/landing/width admission rejects invalid source.
Covered-but-invalid stair observations retain selection precedence rather than falling back to a valid court.
Signed selected floor shifts propagate through checked elevation translation and the disposable affine-probe clone.
Paving cached causes use Arc through framework conversion, with no prose erasure.
applicable_rules: AGENTS.md architecture authority, clean final APIs, preserved ignored evidence, contributor summaries.
crates/AGENTS.md semantic values, native kernel evidence, existing owner reuse, checked operations, no production unwrap/expect in added paths, no tests without request.
crates/adventuresim-tactical-core/AGENTS.md tuning authority; this increment adds no combat tuning.

behavior_limits.normalization: Pinned Bevy 0.19.1/glam 0.33.6 source read only: Dir3 divides by length; successful Vec3 try_normalize uses the same reciprocal multiplication as prior normalize. Optional grass retains normalize_or_zero. Degenerate/nonfinite required normals now reject.
behavior_limits.signed_zero: Original grass centre used local + Vec2::ZERO while mesh/rock centre used local directly. For admitted sampled grids width/depth >=2, bilinear grid coordinates add positive half-grid extents >=0.5, eliminating any difference in a signed zero before sampling/fraction arithmetic. Seam outside-distance uses abs/max; sampled SceneTerrain adds its positive half extent. Owned grass bypasses this aggregate. No valid height/normal/mesh/seed output difference follows from that centre-expression difference. Native normal-probe offset order and f32 interpolation formulas are otherwise preserved.
behavior_limits.offset_origins: LOD scene_point/local_offset preserve old addition/subtraction and f64-to-f32 order. Existing 500/500 inspection and 125/-275 pigment fixtures are preserved. ActiveVistaSurface retains its previous numeric seam policy; this change does not silently correct the old offset-ring interpretation.
behavior_limits.invalid_coarse: Nonfinite coarse native samples remain Some until the completed interpolation is rejected. Malformed coarse metadata is distinct from exterior missing samples and is rejected before fallback/indexing.

acceptance_limits: Existing frozen-manifest/offline ignored cases are adapted but not executed.
No PR-wide primitive or aggregate clearance; all remaining original families stay open.
